integrity: Exact integer transfer recurrence and independent enumeration of all residues for sixteen canonical cases; no floating-point or probabilistic experiments required for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only shifts with exactly three one-bits are classified; no claim for other weights or the full digit-sum-difference law.
Possible equivalent earlier calculation outside the inspected indexed literature; the full text of the 2026 fixed-weight preprint was not obtainable.
title: Five-value spectrum of three-one binary digit-sum shifts
